{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm to ensure accurate mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and calculate mean flipper length
df_grouped = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
df_grouped_sorted = df_grouped.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Display the results
df_grouped_sorted"}
